goal: Dashboard page: score caption, KPI strip, filter form, chips and filtered export links (P1; Board gate 175: removable chip per active filter plus Clear filters, 'table last' = First rows table stays below all charts, no score on it)

acceptance_criteria.text: app/templates/dataset.html: after the page head a <dl class="kpis"> of <div><dt>/<dd> items Rows, Columns, Missing (as '0.0%'), '<column> (sum)' for up to three columns, every figure through the num filter, from the view's kpis (filtered rows when a filter is active)

A <form class="filters" method="get"> with one <div class="field"><label>…</label><select name="f.<column>"> per categorical column (empty first option, options from the view, the active value selected) and <input type="date" name="from">/<input type="date" name="to"> only when a temporal column exists, plus an Apply button; a dataset with no categorical or temporal column (notes.csv) shows no form

While a filter is active a <div class="chips-row"><ul class="chips"> shows one chip per filter with the label (e.g. 'region = North') and a remove link to the current URL without that filter (bare path when none is left), then a 'Clear filters' link to the bare dataset path; none of this is rendered with no filters

Each figure's .chart-rule text ends ' · score 0.NN' using the chart's score (2 decimals, same as the API); there is still exactly one .chart-rule and one .chart-count per figure; the Columns and First rows tables stay after the last , and Export PPTX/XLSX links carry the page's canonical filter query string

Markup matches docs/DESIGN.md Components so the existing databoot.css rules (.kpis, .filters, .field, .chips-row, .chips, first chart full width) apply; CSS is edited only if a measured problem is found at 1280 px and 390 px
